t: You're at number 11 Holland Park, one of the large houses on this leafy street in Kensington. Mary Bagot Stack, known as Mollie, died here in 1935. Born in Ireland, she founded the Women's League of Health and Beauty in 1930. It became the first and most significant mass keep-fit system in Britain in the 1930s, and the exercise system she created has carried on into the twenty-first century. Not a bad legacy for someone who lived on this road.
